title: RetailAnalytics AdSpendStoreSales

stats.done_summary: Completed comprehensive retail analytics analysis for Policy RET-ADV-ROLL. Analyzed 7,200 store-month observations across 200 stores over 3 years. Key findings: (1) Strong ad-spend to sales relationship (R²=0.985, ROAS=35.7x), (2) Holiday months require 3.7-8.3% of prior-month sales as ad budget vs 0.9-2.2% for non-holiday months, (3) Annual budget ~$20.2M with 56% allocated to holiday period. Generated 6 visualization figures and comprehensive report with actionable budget planning recommendations.
